statements.t: “These results support an increase in our full-year outlook and demonstrate the benefits of our return to a focused, pure-play golf company.
With a strong balance sheet and a resilient golf consumer, we remain confident in our ability to strengthen our business and create long-term shareholder value.”
The Company’s net sales from continuing operations decreased 5.6% to $436.9 million, which was better than expected.
As a result of these actions, the Company expected sales in the second half of 2026 to decrease compared to 2025.

The decrease in net sales was partially offset by an increase in TravisMathew net sales in the quarter and overall was better than the Company expected due to the successful launch of the Company’s Mini Spinner fairway woods, as well as the TRTL putters in Asia.
Given the strength of the Company’s third quarter results and improved outlook, the Company increased its full-year net sales and Adjusted EBITDA guidance.
